meta.title: Book a First Call with Genixo
meta.description: Book a 30-minute first call with Genixo. We listen to how the work gets done today and tell you where software and AI would help, or that we're not a fit.

hero.title: Book a first call
hero.lead: Thirty minutes about the process that costs your team the most time. You leave with an honest view of where to start, or a clear “we're not the right fit”.

answer.label: In short
answer.text: To start working with Genixo, send the form below or call +90 312 265 04 56. The first call takes about 30 minutes: we ask how the work is done today, which systems you use and what you have tried, then suggest a first step. Our office is at Bilkent Cyberpark, Ankara.

sections.label: Send a message
sections.title: Tell us about the process
sections.lead: Four fields; only the budget is optional. We reply by email. [[TODO-008]]

items.title: How it works today
items.text: Who does the work, how often, with which tools, and where it slows down or goes wrong.

items.title: What you've tried
items.text: Packages, spreadsheets, earlier projects: what worked, what didn't and why.

items.title: Constraints
items.text: Budget range, timing, systems that must stay, and where your data may be processed.

items.title: A first step
items.text: Our honest view of where to start, or that we're not the right team for it.

sections.label: To prepare
sections.title: Questions worth thinking about before the call
items: Which task takes your team the most hours each week?
Roughly how many times a month does it happen?
Which systems are involved, such as your ERP, CRM, spreadsheets or messaging groups?
What would “better” look like in six months?

sections.label: After the call
sections.title: What happens next
paragraphs: After the call we send a short written summary of what we heard and the first step we suggest. [[TODO-009]]
If there is a fit, the first step is scoped and priced separately: see [pricing and timelines](/pricing).
